description:
Add Service

Adds a service to a Load Balancer.

#### Operation specific errors

| Status | Code | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `412` | `source_port_already_used` | The source port you are trying to add is already in use |

destination_port.description: Port the Load Balancer will balance to.

domain.description: Host header to send in the HTTP request. May not contain spaces, percent or backslash symbols. Can be null, in that case no host header is sent.

path.description: HTTP path to use for health checks. May not contain literal spaces, use percent-encoding instead.

response.description: String that must be contained in HTTP response in order to pass the health check.

status_codes.description: List of returned HTTP status codes in order to pass the health check. Supports the wildcards `?` for exactly one character and `*` for multiple ones.

interval.description: Time interval in seconds health checks are performed.

port.description: Port the health check will be performed on.

retries.description: Unsuccessful retries needed until a target is considered unhealthy; an unhealthy target needs the same number of successful retries to become healthy again.

timeout.description: Time in seconds after an attempt is considered a timeout.

listen_port.description: Port the Load Balancer listens on.

http.description: Configuration option for protocols http and https.

certificates.description: IDs of the Certificates to use for TLS/SSL termination by the Load Balancer; empty for TLS/SSL passthrough or if `protocol` is `http`.

cookie_lifetime.description: Lifetime of the cookie used for sticky sessions (in seconds).

cookie_name.description: Name of the cookie used for sticky sessions.

redirect_http.description: Redirect HTTP requests to HTTPS. Only available if `protocol` is `https`.

sticky_sessions.description: Use sticky sessions. Only available if `protocol` is `http` or `https`.

timeout_idle.description: Idle timeout in seconds for the client and server side.

http.title: LoadBalancerServiceHTTP

wait.description: Poll the resulting action until success/error or timeout.
